# GapPairs — prime pairs at any even gap, and Goldbach pairs

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** planned: new, not yet proved · **Diagram:** [Gaps between survivors and between primes](../../GRAPH.md#gaps-between-survivors-and-between-primes)

Prime pairs up to N a fixed even gap apart number at most a constant times the gap over Euler's phi of the gap, times N over log N squared; pairs of primes adding to a given even number are bounded the same way. Ford, Corollary 2.6.
